(() => { const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('span,div,p,td')].find(e=> e.childElementCount===0 && /^Purchased\s+2026-03-15/.test(e.textContent.trim())); return el ? {tag:el.tagName, cls:el.className, text:el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()} : 'not found as leaf'; })()

(() => { const res={}; const badge=document.querySelector('main .badge, main span.label'); res.statusBadge = badge?badge.innerText.trim():null; res.assignedToLink = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/users/"]')].map(a=>({t:a.innerText.trim(), href:a.getAttribute('href'), title:a.getAttribute('title')})); res.locationLinks=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/locations/"]')].map(a=>({t:a.innerText.trim(),href:a.getAttribute('href')})); return res; })()

(() => { const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input, [role="textbox"], [contenteditable="true"]')).filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null); return els.map((e,i)=>({i, tag:e.tagName, cls:(e.className||'').toString().slice(0,100), type:e.type, val:e.value, ph:e.placeholder, aria:e.getAttribute('aria-label')})); })()

(() => { const btn = document.querySelector('button[title*="2026"], button[aria-label*="2026"]') ; const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main button')).filter(b=>/2026|due|Save|Remind/i.test((b.getAttribute('title')||'')+(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')+b.innerText)); return els.map(b=>({t:(b.innerText||'').slice(0,40), title:b.getAttribute('title'), aria:b.getAttribute('aria-label'), cls:(b.className||'').toString().slice(0,120), vis:b.offsetParent!==null})); })()
